summary: GATX Corporation filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing Five Year Credit Agreement. The amendment extends the termination date from May 21, 2030 to May 21, 2031, reduces applicable margins for SOFR and ABR borrowings based on public credit rating grids, and decreases facility fees. This is a routine refinancing and extension of a credit facility, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other corporate event is involved. The filing is a standard material definitive agreement and obligation disclosure.
